validity.recommendation: Keep as-is; fill blank endpoints (EWPS-1 -> Shedgum). Note P6717/P6718 are the two parallel lines (EWGP-3 + EWGP-4) of one EPC package, not a duplicate to merge.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and physically under construction. This is Package 3 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3), independently and explicitly described as the 'EWPS-1 to Shedgum Pipeline' by DMS Projects (PRJ00030604), and by Blackridge Research whose scope table reads verbatim: 'Lay 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-1 to Shedgum (56km).' MEED and Zawya both confirm Gas Arabian (Services) was awarded EPC on packages 3 & 12, scope = laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines 3 and 4 from EWPS-1 to Shedgum, 56 km. Construction commenced Q2 2024, completion Q4 2028. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: confirmed gas TRANSMISSION/trunk line (dry sales gas; MGS carries non-associated/unconventional sales gas and related condensate across the kingdom). Not NGL, not gathering. PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas are correct. DUPLICATE: NOT a true duplicate. P6717 ('3') and P6718 ('3' in roster, the parallel line) together are the two parallel 56-inch lines EWGP-3 and EWGP-4 of the single 56 km Package 3 (28 km + 28 km = 56 km). The split into two 28-km rows reflects two physically distinct parallel pipes, which is a legitimate modeling choice; flagging as a CAVEAT only so a reviewer knows P6717 and P6718 are siblings within one EPC package, not independent unrelated pipelines. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% confirmed (Aramco is the asset owner; Gas Arabian is only the EPC contractor). SPEC: diameter 56-in confirmed by MEED, Blackridge, Zawya. Length 28 km is half of the 56 km Package-3 total, consistent with one of the two parallel lines. SegmentCost $46M is ~half of the $91.89M package value (MEED) / ~SAR344.6M Shedgum-EWPS-1 contract (Goalfore) -- a per-segment allocation, not directly sourced as $46M; reasonable but soft. StartYear 2028 supported by the independently-confirmed Q4 2028 completion date.

fills.researcher_notes: Endpoints were blank in GEM (Location ref MISSING). Package 3 scope is laying 56-inch lines EWGP-3 and EWGP-4 'from EWPS-1 to Shedgum' (MEED, Blackridge, DMS Projects all name this package the 'EWPS-1 to Shedgum Pipeline'). Start=EWPS-1 (East-West Pump Station 1, on Aramco's east-west gas corridor), End=Shedgum (Shedgum gas plant hub, Eastern Province). >=2 independent sources agree.

Existing Start ref (Zawya) failed the value-check for '2028'. Replacing/supplementing with Blackridge, which gives MGS-3 construction timeline Q2 2024 -> Q4 2028 (project-wide completion); a 2028 in-service start for this package is consistent with the package's Q4 2028 completion. Medium tier: the 2028 is the program completion year, not a per-segment commissioning date explicitly stated for EWPS-1->Shedgum line 3.

summary: P6717 (MGS-3 Package 3, EWPS-1->Shedgum 56-in line EWGP-3) confirmed real, gas transmission, Aramco-owned, in construction; caveat: P6717+P6718 are the two parallel lines of one 56 km package; filled blank endpoints (EWPS-1->Shedgum) and Start (2028).
